prompt.label: Easy/Medium — Slow Employee Onboarding (NON-AI, workflow)
prompt.userMessage: As we continue hiring across multiple countries, onboarding new employees has become increasingly inconsistent and time-consuming. HR, IT, Legal, and department managers all operate with separate processes, so simple things like equipment access or compliance training often fall through the cracks. New hires sometimes wait more than a week before they can fully contribute, which is hurting productivity and first impressions. We want to create a smoother onboarding experience that feels coordinated and scalable as the company grows.

rounds.content:
{
  "action": "clarify",
  "round": 1,
  "message": "Got it — onboarding is currently fragmented across HR, IT, Legal, and managers, and new hires are losing a week+ of productivity. There are a few different products that could solve this. Which is closest to what you want?

A) Onboarding workflow tracker — a checklist/task system per new hire, assigned across HR/IT/Legal/manager, with status visibility and deadlines (no AI, humans drive the work)

B) Self-serve new hire portal — new hires log in and see their personalized onboarding journey (forms, training, equipment requests, docs to sign), while back-office teams get task queues

C) AI onboarding assistant — new hires ask questions in plain English ("how do I request a laptop?", "what's the parental leave policy?") and get cited answers from your internal policies, plus a basic task list

D) Full coordination hub — combines B (new hire portal + back-office queues) with manager dashboards, cross-team handoffs, and email reminders when tasks stall"
}

  "action": "clarify",

  "message": "Perfect — an onboarding workflow tracker with assigned tasks across HR/IT/Legal/managers, status visibility, and deadlines. A few things we can wire in automatically — pick any that sound useful:

A) Email notifications when tasks are assigned, due soon, or overdue
